start:
Welcome to use this bot. All your messages sent to me will be forwarded to the admin.
Enter command /notification can toggle message sending notification status, off by default.
notification_on: Enabled message sending notification. The bot will give a feedback when it receives your message.
notification_off: Disabled message sending notification. The bot will not give a feedback when it receives your message.
message_received_notification: Your message has been forwarded to the admin.
reply_to_message_no_data: No data of this message. Cannot inquire or reply.
reply_type_not_supported: Do not support to reply the user this type of message.
blocked_alert: This user stopped the bot so you cannot reply.
be_blocked_alert: You won't be able to send messages to the admin because you have been banned.
reply_or_enter_id: Reply to a relayed message or enter a user ID.
verification_required: Please verify before sending messages. Tap the button below.
verification_success: Verification complete. Please send your message again.
verification_failed: Verification failed or expired. Send /start to try again.
help_user:
tego %s
Send a message here to contact the admin anonymously. The admin's reply comes through this bot.
/start - Start or request a fresh verification button
/notification - Toggle delivery confirmations
/status - Check whether the bot is running
/help - Show this help
If verification is enabled, complete it first, then send your message again.
https://github.com/Debcharon/tego
help_admin:
tego %s
Reply to a relayed message to answer anonymously.
/start - Open admin panel
/info - Reply to view sender
/ban - Reply or use /ban <user ID>
/unban - Reply or use /unban <user ID>
/banlist - Browse banned users
/unverify - Reply or use /unverify <user ID>
/notification - Toggle confirmations
/status - Show version and verification mode
/help - Show this help
https://github.com/Debcharon/tego
unverify_done: Verification revoked for user %d. Their next message will require verification again.
panel_home:
tego %s · Admin panel
Choose an action:
panel_invalid: This panel action is no longer available. Send /start to reopen it.
panel_status_detail:
tego %s
Verification: %s
Users: %d
